BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION)

CLASS: BE   SEMESTER: VII
BRANCH: CS/IT   SESSION: MO/2022

SUBJECT: IT426 DATA MINING CONCEPTS & TECHNIQUES

TIME: 2 HOURS   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The total marks of the questions are 25.
2. Candidates attempt for all 25 marks.
3. Before attempting the question paper, be sure that you have got the correct question paper.
4. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
5. Tables/Data hand book/Graph paper etc. to be supplied to the candidates in the examination hall.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



    CO BL
Q1 (a) Explain  the  terms  “interestingness”  and  “concept  hierarchies”  with  proper
examples.
[2] 1 1
Q1 (b) Describe at least three Data Mining Task primitives with examples. [3] 1 1


Q2 (a) Use min max normalization (using min=0 and max=1) an z-score normalization
to normalize the values 200, 300, 400, 600, 1000.
[2] 2 2
Q2 (b) The marks obtained by a group of students in increasing order is given as 13, 15,
16, 16, 19, 20, 20, 21, 22, 22, 25, 25, 25, 25, 30, 33, 33, 35, 35, 35, 35, 36, 40,
45, 46, 52, 70. Assuming that the outlier limits are the 5th and 95th quantiles,
partition the data using the 3-4-5 technique.
[3] 2 3

Q3 (a) Differentiate  between  characterization  and  discrimination  with  suitable
examples
[2] 1 2
Q3 (b) A  public  opinion  poll  surveyed  a  simple  random  sample  of  1000  voters.
Respondents  were  classified  by  gender  (male  or  female)  and  by  voting
preference  (Republican,  Democrat,  or  Independent).  Results  are  shown  in
the contingency table below.

GENDER VOTING PREFERENCES
REPUBLIC DEMOCRAT INDEPENDENT
MALE 200 150 50
FEMALE 250 300 50

Obtain Correlation among the attributes using Chi-Square method,
(Given for 2 degree of freedom Chi-Square value to reject the hypothesis at
the 0.005 significance level is 10.597)
[3] 2 2

Q4 (a) Comparison between OLTP  with OLAP systems [2] 2 1
Q4 (b) Explain the three-tier architecture of data warehouse with suitable diagram. [3] 2 2

Q5 (a) Show how to index OLAP data by bitmap indexing with suitable example.   [2] 2 2
Q5 (b) Design a  data warehouse  consists of the three dimensions time, doctor, and
patient, and the two measures count and charge, where charge is the fee that
a doctor charges a patient for a visit.
(i) Enumerate three classes of schemas that are popularly used for modeling
data warehouses.
(ii)  Draw  a  Snowflake  schema  diagram  for  the  above  data  warehouse  using
classes listed in (i).
[3] 2 3

1. The total marks of the questions are 25.
2. Candidates attempt for all 25 marks.
3. Before attempting the question paper, be sure that you have got the correct question paper.
4. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
5. Tables/Data hand book/Graph paper etc. to be supplied to the candidates in the examination hall.

    CO BL
Q1 (a) Discuss the different issues in Data Mining. [2] 1 2
Q1 (b) What  is  the  difference  between  discrimination  and classification, between
characterization  and  clustering,  between  classification  and  prediction?  For
each of these pairs of tasks, how are they similar?
[3] 2 2

Q2 (a) Briefly describe  the following database system: Temporal, Spatial,  and Time-
Series databases
[2] 1 2
Q2 (b) Discuss (shortly) whether each of the following activities is a data mining task
or not.
(i)  Dividing the customers of a company according to their profitability
(ii) Predicting the outcomes of tossing a (fair) pair of dice.
(iii)Predicting the future stock price of a company using historical records.
(iv)Monitoring the heart rate of a patient for abnormalities.
(v) Extracting the frequencies of a sound wave.
(vi) Social Impacts on Smart Phone.
[3] 2 2

Q3 (a) Discuss the different issues to be consider during data integration. [2] 2 2
Q3 (b) Given the following measurements for the variable age:
18; 22; 25; 42; 28; 43; 33; 35; 56; 28;
Standardize the variable by the following:
(i) Compute the mean absolute deviation of age.
(ii) Compute the z-score for the first four measurements.
[3] 2 3

Q4 (a) Explain the  different OLAP operations  on multidimensional  data with suitable
example.
[2] 2 2
Q4 (b) Explain the  architectural elements  of  the  Data  Warehouse  with  a  suitable
diagram
[3] 2 2

Q5 (a) Explain  how  the  bitmap  indexing  method  implement  in  Data  Warehouse with
suitable diagram.
[2] 2 2
Q5 (b) What are the different schemas for multidimensional databases and implement
any  one  schema  for  “Sales”  that  connected  with  Item,  Time,  Locations,  and
Branch.
[3] 2 3
